title: 第13章 盗得宝药第14章 六十年一轮回
content_zh:
就在这时，章鱼手臂的猎人从怀中一阵摸索，竟出来一条黑漆漆的活蚯蚓。
他把扭曲的黑蚯蚓递向张楚几个人：“几位兄弟，别客气，这是我们五柳村的宝药，拿去吧！”
“宝药？”张楚几个人感觉毛骨悚然，这玩意儿怎么会是药！
而那个猎人队的队长却很自豪的说道：“没错，这就是宝药，是我们的柳树神赐予我们的，吃了之后，力气大增！”
紧接着，他很豪爽的喊道：“我们的柳树神很大度，它希望所有人都能变得强大，无论你是不是我们的村民，都可以吃到宝药。”
“拿着上路吧，万一遇到危险，或许能救你们一命。”
分明是恶心无比的东西，但张楚几个人却听出了这猎人的好意。
当然，张楚几个人不可能接受。
此时童青山急忙摆手：“不，还是不了……”
那个猎人队长也没生气，又把那条蚯蚓揣入了怀中。
而后，他用那根正常的手臂对张楚几个人拱手：“既然这样，我们就不多打扰了，请！”
说着，他们主动让开了道路。
张楚几个人急忙通过。
而那些被污染的人，却还在张楚几个人身后大喊：“枣叶村的兄弟们，一定要小心，莽砀山的那条怪蟒可不简单！”
“要是遇到危险，就来我们五柳村，大家都在妖墟混生活，理应相互帮助！”
张楚几个人则奔跑着离去，生怕他们追上来。
饶是他们体魄强健，也跑的气喘吁吁，丝毫不敢停留。
一边跑，童青羽还一边回头观望。
大概跑了半个时辰，他们早已经脱离了五柳村的范围，童青羽这才放松下来：“他们没追来！”
几个人这才扑通一声坐在了地上，大口喘着气，每个人脸上都是心有余悸的表情。

“太可怕了！”童青羽死死的握着大弓的弓背，手腕还是忍不住哆嗦。
童青山则问张楚：“先生，这污染，究竟是什么？这也太诡异了。”
张楚则回忆他们的表现，终于，张楚说道：
“看他们的样子，他们自己意识不到，他们已经变成了那个样子。在他们的意识里，他们觉得，他们还是正常人。”
“正常人那个样子，怎么可能活的下去！”刚子说道。
张楚也叹了一口气，完全想不通。
说实话，这些被污染的村民，如果直接动手攻击他们，他们都可以接受。
偏偏他们如此的热情，如此的“正常”，反倒是让张楚感觉毛骨悚然。
“算了，离他们远一点吧，只要我们自己不被污染就好。”张楚说道。
……
莽砀山。
content_en:
At this moment, the hunter with the octopus arm fumbled around in his arms and unexpectedly came out with a dark, live earthworm.
He handed the twisted black earthworm to Zhang Chu and others: "Brothers, you're welcome, this is the treasure of our Wuliu Village, take it!"
"Precious medicine?" Zhang Chu and others felt horrified. How could this thing be medicine?
But the captain of the hunter team said proudly: "Yes, this is the treasure medicine. It was given to us by our willow tree god. After taking it, our strength will be greatly increased!"
Immediately afterwards, he shouted boldly: "Our willow tree god is very generous. He hopes that everyone can become strong. Regardless of whether you are one of our villagers, you can take the precious medicine."
"Take it and go on the road. If you encounter danger, it may save your life."
It was clearly something extremely disgusting, but Zhang Chu and the others could hear the hunter's good intentions.
Of course, it is impossible for Zhang Chu and others to accept it.
At this time, Tong Qingshan waved his hands hurriedly: "No, it's still not possible..."
The hunter captain was not angry either, and put the earthworm into his arms again.
Then, he used his normal arm to hand over Zhang Chu and the others: "In this case, we won't disturb you anymore, please!"
With that said, they took the initiative to get out of the way.
Zhang Chu and others hurriedly passed.
But those who were polluted were still shouting behind Zhang Chu and others: "Brothers in Zaoye Village, be careful, that strange python in Mangdang Mountain is not simple!"
"If you encounter danger, come to our Wuliu Village. We all live in the Demon Ruins, so we should help each other!"
Zhang Chu and others ran away, fearing that they would catch up.
Even though they were physically strong, they were out of breath running and did not dare to stop at all.
While running, Tong Qingyu looked back.
After running for about half an hour, they had already left the confines of Wuliu Village. Tong Qingyu relaxed and said, "They are not chasing us!"
Then several people plopped down on the ground, gasping for air, with lingering expressions of fear on their faces.
"It's too scary!" Tong Qingyu held the back of the big bow tightly, and his wrist could not help but tremble.
Tong Qingshan asked Zhang Chu: "Sir, what exactly is this pollution? This is too weird."
Zhang Chu recalled their performance. Finally, Zhang Chu said:
"Looking at their appearance, they don't realize that they have become like that. In their consciousness, they feel that they are still normal people."
"How can a normal person survive like that!" Gangzi said.
Zhang Chu also sighed, completely confused.
To be honest, if these contaminated villagers were attacked directly, they would be able to accept it.
However, they were so enthusiastic and "normal" that it actually made Zhang Chu feel creepy.
"Forget it, stay away from them, as long as we ourselves are not contaminated." Zhang Chu said.
…
Mangdang Mountain.
